roles.name: Super Administrator
roles.description: Manages the public AIZEN website and has full access to the Risk Management solution.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Full access to all modules, master data, users, roles, matrix and settings.

roles.name: Risk Manager
roles.description: Administers the risk module and may manage all risk records, assessments, owners, controls and actions.

roles.name: Risk Owner
roles.description: Owns assigned risks and may update assigned risk assessments, controls and remediation plans.

roles.name: Control Owner
roles.description: Maintains controls assigned to them and records design/operating effectiveness information.

roles.name: Action Owner
roles.description: Updates assigned remediation actions, progress and delivery dates.

risks.title: Sensitive information assets are mixed with information assets of lesser criticality
risks.cause: Lack of a documented methodology and process for data classification across environments.
risks.event: Sensitive information may be processed or stored together with lower-criticality assets without appropriate protection.
risks.consequence: Confidentiality breaches, regulatory fines, licence impact, revenue loss and reputational damage.
risks.statusNarrative: The information architecture methodology is being formalised. Delivery is dependent on the cloud migration programme.

actions.title: Data classification methodology
actions.description: Document the methodology and apply it to priority environments.
actions.deliverable: Approved data classification standard and labelled priority datasets.

risks.title: Lack of security monitoring
risks.cause: Not all sensitive assets and critical services are integrated with monitoring solutions.
risks.event: A security incident may remain undetected or may not be investigated promptly.
risks.consequence: Confidentiality, integrity or availability loss, fines and licence impact.
risks.statusNarrative: Priority integrations are in progress and exception ownership is being formalised.

controls.title: Central SIEM monitoring
controls.description: Priority security telemetry is integrated into central SIEM with on-call triage.
controls.intendedOutcome: Known vulnerabilities are identified early and assigned for remediation.

actions.title: Integrate exception assets into SIEM
actions.description: Assess and integrate remaining high-priority exceptions.
actions.deliverable: All critical assets covered or formally risk accepted.
actions.notes: Cloud-native sources are in the final onboarding wave.

risks.title: Insufficient cyber security awareness
risks.cause: Cyber security training and communication do not consistently reach all staff populations.
risks.event: Employees may not identify or respond appropriately to phishing and social engineering.
risks.consequence: Confidential information loss, operational disruption, regulatory fines and reputational harm.
risks.statusNarrative: Training completion is improving; targeted campaigns remain in progress.

controls.title: Mandatory cyber awareness programme
controls.description: Mandatory onboarding and annual refresher training, supported by phishing simulations.
controls.intendedOutcome: Employees identify and report suspicious activity.
controls.evidenceLocation: Learning management system and phishing platform

actions.title: Increase completion to 90%
actions.description: Follow up overdue participants and repeat failed simulations.
actions.deliverable: At least 90% completion and improved simulation results.

risks.title: Sensitive data is not consistently encrypted at rest
risks.cause: Legacy systems were implemented without consistent encryption baselines.
risks.event: Sensitive information may be exposed if storage is compromised.
risks.consequence: Privacy breach, legal and regulatory penalties, customer harm and reputation loss.
risks.statusNarrative: Encryption design is approved; implementation is aligned to platform modernisation.

actions.title: Implement encryption baseline
actions.description: Enable encryption and complete risk-based exceptions.
actions.deliverable: Encrypted priority systems and approved exceptions.

risks.title: Data is retained beyond approved retention periods
risks.cause: Some systems do not have automated retention and deletion mechanisms.
risks.event: Data may remain available beyond its lawful or business retention period.
risks.consequence: Regulatory non-compliance, privacy harm, increased breach exposure and fines.
risks.statusNarrative: Data mapping is progressing; deletion automation depends on system capabilities.

actions.title: Implement retention controls
actions.description: Map in-scope data and automate deletion where possible.
actions.deliverable: Approved retention inventory and disposal controls.

risks.title: Insufficient pre-production patch testing
risks.cause: Representative testing environments and release criteria are incomplete for some products.
risks.event: A patch may cause service instability or fail to remediate the intended vulnerability.
risks.consequence: Availability loss, operational disruption and extended security exposure.
risks.statusNarrative: Testing requirements are approved and environment build-out is underway.

controls.title: Patch testing and release approval
controls.description: Documented patch management process covering identification, prioritisation, testing, deployment, exception handling and closure.
controls.intendedOutcome: Critical and high vulnerabilities are remediated within the approved SLA.
controls.evidenceLocation: Security governance workspace / patch compliance reports

actions.title: Establish representative test environments
actions.description: Define, build and document pre-production environments.
actions.deliverable: Test coverage and release evidence for all critical products.

custom.attr_kri: Critical products without patch test coverage

risks.title: Critical vulnerabilities are not remediated within agreed timescales
risks.cause: The patch management workflow is fragmented and some maintenance windows, ownership rules and exception paths are not standardised.
risks.event: Threat actors may exploit known vulnerabilities during extended remediation windows.
risks.consequence: System compromise, unauthorised access, ransomware, service disruption, financial loss, regulatory exposure and reputational damage.
risks.statusNarrative: An enterprise remediation programme is addressing the overdue backlog, strengthening the security baseline and introducing consistent prioritisation and verification.

controls.title: Signed-off Patch Management Process & Technical Workflows
controls.description: Documented patch management process covering identification, prioritisation, testing, deployment, exception handling and closure.
controls.intendedOutcome: Critical and high vulnerabilities are remediated within the approved SLA.
controls.evidenceLocation: Security governance workspace / patch compliance reports

controls.title: Authenticated Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Authenticated scans of server and cloud estate with prioritised reporting and tracked exceptions.
controls.intendedOutcome: Known vulnerabilities are identified early and assigned for remediation.

actions.title: Visibility & Governance
actions.description: Establish unified authenticated scanning and reporting for on-premise and cloud environments.
actions.deliverable: Automated dashboard reporting on SLA breaches and unresolved critical vulnerabilities.

actions.title: Process & Flow
actions.description: Implement the standard patch management process, maintenance windows, testing cycles and deployment pipelines.
actions.deliverable: Signed-off patch management process and technical workflows.
actions.notes: Completed; likelihood reduced from 4 to 3 in the previous assessment.

actions.title: Execution & Remediation
actions.description: Remediate the vulnerability backlog within the approved SLA timeframes.
actions.deliverable: 90%+ SLA compliance with no unresolved critical vulnerabilities outside approved exceptions.

audit.summary: Residual assessment changed from 12 to 12 with revised impact/likelihood rationale.
Process & Flow remediation action marked Completed.

risks.title: Data leakage through communication channels
risks.cause: The current DLP coverage does not consistently include all communication channels.
risks.event: Sensitive data may be transferred outside approved destinations.
risks.consequence: Personal or confidential data exposure, legal obligations, customer harm and reputational loss.
risks.statusNarrative: A replacement DLP solution is being implemented and high-risk channels are prioritised.

controls.title: DLP monitoring for priority channels
controls.description: DLP policies monitor priority communication channels and generate alerts.
controls.intendedOutcome: Sensitive transfers are blocked or investigated.

actions.title: Implement modern DLP
actions.description: Deploy and tune the replacement DLP platform.
actions.deliverable: Coverage of all priority communication channels.

audit.summary: Emerging risk added to the register.

globalAudit.summary: Residual assessment changed from 12 to 12 with revised impact/likelihood rationale.
Process & Flow remediation action marked Completed.
Emerging risk added to the register.

reportTemplates.name: Executive risk report
reportTemplates.description: A reusable management report combining the enterprise dashboard, commentary and a compact risk register.
reportTemplates.descriptionKa: ხელახლა გამოყენებადი მენეჯმენტის ანგარიში, რომელიც აერთიანებს დეშბორდს, კომენტარსა და რისკ-რეესტრის კომპაქტურ ვერსიას.

sections.title: Management commentary
sections.text: Use this section for key movements, decisions, escalations and management commentary.
sections.textKa: გამოიყენეთ ეს სექცია მნიშვნელოვანი ცვლილებების, გადაწყვეტილებების, ესკალაციებისა და მენეჯმენტის კომენტარებისთვის.

siteContent.heroEyebrow: Governance technology that grows with you
siteContent.heroEyebrowKa: მმართველობის ტექნოლოგია, რომელიც თქვენთან ერთად ვითარდება
siteContent.heroTitle: Turn risk decisions into visible, accountable action.
siteContent.heroTitleKa: გადააქციეთ რისკის გადაწყვეტილებები გამჭვირვალე და ანგარიშვალდებულ ქმედებებად.
siteContent.heroDescription: A clear workspace for risk identification, 5×5 assessment, controls, remediation, dashboards and management reporting — ready today in the Risk Management solution.
siteContent.heroDescriptionKa: ერთიანი სამუშაო სივრცე რისკების იდენტიფიკაციისთვის, 5×5 შეფასებისთვის, კონტროლებისთვის, რემედიაციისთვის, დეშბორდებისა და მენეჯმენტის ანგარიშგებისთვის — Risk Management გადაწყვეტა უკვე ხელმისაწვდომია.
siteContent.solutionsTitle: One platform. A growing governance suite.
siteContent.solutionsDescription: Start with enterprise risk management today. Compliance and audit workspaces are presented transparently as planned modules.
siteContent.solutionsDescriptionKa: დაიწყეთ საწარმოს რისკების მართვით დღესვე. შესაბამისობისა და აუდიტის სამუშაო სივრცეები გამჭვირვალედ არის წარმოდგენილი, როგორც დაგეგმილი მოდულები.
siteContent.aboutDescription: AIZEN Risk & Compliance is a technology-driven risk and compliance platform, built to help organizations strengthen governance, manage risk, and meet regulatory requirements with confidence.
siteContent.aboutDescriptionKa: AIZEN Risk & Compliance არის ტექნოლოგიაზე დაფუძნებული რისკებისა და შესაბამისობის პლატფორმა, რომელიც ორგანიზაციებს ეხმარება მმართველობის გაძლიერებაში, რისკების მართვასა და რეგულაციური მოთხოვნების თავდაჯერებულად შესრულებაში.
siteContent.aboutReachDescription: We currently operate in one market, with a focused approach that enables us to understand local business needs, regulatory requirements, and industry challenges in depth.
siteContent.aboutReachDescriptionKa: ამ ეტაპზე ერთ ბაზარზე ვოპერირებთ. ფოკუსირებული მიდგომა საშუალებას გვაძლევს სიღრმისეულად გავიგოთ ადგილობრივი ბიზნესის საჭიროებები, რეგულაციური მოთხოვნები და ინდუსტრიის გამოწვევები.
siteContent.aboutPeopleDescription: Our team brings together some of the market’s leading technology professionals, combining deep expertise in innovation, risk management, compliance, and digital transformation.
siteContent.aboutPeopleDescriptionKa: ჩვენი გუნდი აერთიანებს ბაზრის წამყვან ტექნოლოგიურ პროფესიონალებს და ღრმა გამოცდილებას ინოვაციებში, რისკების მართვაში, შესაბამისობასა და ციფრულ ტრანსფორმაციაში.
siteContent.aboutClientsDescription: We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance processes through practical, intelligent, and scalable technology solutions.
siteContent.aboutClientsDescriptionKa: ორგანიზაციებს ვეხმარებით რისკებისა და შესაბამისობის პროცესების გამარტივებაში პრაქტიკული, ინტელექტუალური და მასშტაბირებადი ტექნოლოგიური გადაწყვეტილებებით.
siteContent.aboutVisionDescription: We aim to make risk and compliance management simpler, more transparent, and more effective—empowering businesses to make informed decisions and grow with confidence.
siteContent.aboutVisionDescriptionKa: ჩვენი მიზანია რისკებისა და შესაბამისობის მართვა გავხადოთ უფრო მარტივი, გამჭვირვალე და ეფექტური, რათა ბიზნესებმა მიიღონ ინფორმირებული გადაწყვეტილებები და თავდაჯერებულად გაიზარდონ.
siteContent.teamDescription: Meet the specialists shaping our products, customer experience and practical governance outcomes.
siteContent.teamDescriptionKa: გაიცანით სპეციალისტები, რომლებიც ქმნიან ჩვენს პროდუქტებს, მომხმარებლის გამოცდილებასა და პრაქტიკული მმართველობის შედეგებს.
siteContent.videoTitle: See the Risk Management workspace in action
siteContent.videoDescription: A concise walkthrough of configurable dashboards, the risk register, individual risk records, controls, remediation actions and management reports.
siteContent.videoDescriptionKa: მოკლე მიმოხილვა კონფიგურირებადი დეშბორდების, რისკ-რეესტრის, ინდივიდუალური რისკების, კონტროლების, რემედიაციის ქმედებებისა და მენეჯმენტის ანგარიშების შესახებ.
videoHighlights: Assess inherent, residual and target risk
Track controls, actions, owners and deadlines
videoHighlightsKa: შეაფასეთ თავდაპირველი, არსებული და სამიზნე რისკი
აკონტროლეთ კონტროლები, ქმედებები, მფლობელები და ვადები
siteContent.footerText: Plan clearly. Manage accountably. Grow with confidence.
siteContent.footerTextKa: დაგეგმეთ მკაფიოდ. მართეთ პასუხისმგებლობით. გაიზარდეთ თავდაჯერებით.

solutions.name: Risk Management
solutions.description: Maintain a governed risk register, assess inherent/residual/target exposure, document controls and drive remediation to closure.
solutions.descriptionKa: მართეთ რისკ-რეესტრი, შეაფასეთ თავდაპირველი/არსებული/სამიზნე რისკი, აღწერეთ კონტროლები და მიიყვანეთ რემედიაცია დასრულებამდე.
features: AI assistance for assessments and control mapping
featuresKa: AI დახმარება შეფასებებსა და კონტროლების დაკავშირებაში

solutions.name: Compliance Management
solutions.description: A planned workspace for obligations, regulatory change, internal standards, monitoring, evidence and compliance issues.
solutions.descriptionKa: დაგეგმილი სამუშაო სივრცე ვალდებულებების, რეგულაციური ცვლილებების, შიდა სტანდარტების, მონიტორინგის, მტკიცებულებებისა და შესაბამისობის საკითხებისთვის.
features: Internal policy and standards compliance management
featuresKa: შიდა პოლიტიკებისა და სტანდარტების შესაბამისობის მართვა

solutions.name: Audit Management
solutions.description: A planned workspace for evidence, audit delivery, intelligent review, reporting, findings and follow-up.
solutions.descriptionKa: დაგეგმილი სამუშაო სივრცე მტკიცებულებების, აუდიტის შესრულების, ინტელექტუალური შემოწმების, ანგარიშგების, მიგნებებისა და შემდგომი კონტროლისთვის.
featuresKa: AI-ზე დაფუძნებული მტკიცებულებების შემოწმება და რეკომენდაციები
